messages:
sam: Heads-up — rolling out RBAC refactor for service accounts now. The change tightens the default 'service-account' role: remove 'api_keys.read' and require explicit 'api_keys.list' for list operations. Will monitor for 15m, ping if you see 403s.

elena: seeing 403 from our integration tests hitting /v1/api-keys/list — started ~2m after rollout. stacktrace: `403 PermissionDenied: missing api_keys.list`.

mike: confirming, production staging runs also show failures for a handful of internal agents (dedicated pools). Looks like some SAs never had api_keys.list granted in the new role mapping.

security-bot: [alert] 1749005200 - Suspicious increase in permission errors on /v1/api-keys/list (x17). Affected principals: service:ingestion-worker, service:metrics-exporter.

sam: thanks. immediate mitigations: 1) adding temporary override granting api_keys.list to service:ingestion-worker and service:metrics-exporter via emergency-grants; 2) pausing rollout to remaining tenants. Doing 1 now.

elena: thx. any guidance for teams on how to update SDKs? our node SDK wraps the call and surfaces 403 as generic error.

devex: quick guidance: SDK should detect 403 and surface a PermissionError with scope details. Suggested snippet to include in next minor release:

```js
// client.generateApiKeyList() wrapper
try {
  await client.apiKeys.list()
} catch (err) {
  if (err.statusCode === 403) {
    throw new PermissionError('missing_permission', { missing: 'api_keys.list', hint: 'request service account or use token with api_keys.list' })
  }
  throw err
}
```

docs-bot: opened PR: https://repo.redwood.internal/docs/pulls/462 - "RBAC: service-account role changes and mitigation" includes FAQ and step-by-step grant commands (kubectl/kms policy examples).

mike: note: audit logs show the original role-to-permission mapping had a small typo in the matcher (resource == "api_key" vs resource == "api_keys"). I pushed a fix to the role-mapper; that will prevent misclassification going forward. Impact: some legacy SAs were mapped to a minimal role that lacked the list permission.

ir-team: filing an incident ticket and scheduling a short postmortem. Primary action items: faster canary for permission changes, add unit tests for role matcher, extend audit logging to capture role mapping diffs. Assigning owners now.

sam: rollout paused and emergency grants applied. Plan: patch role-mapper, run a dry-run report to detect affected principals, then resume staged rollout with canary=5 tenants. ETA ~45m. If anyone still sees failures after 1749005389, ping here or @infra-oncall.

elena: confirmed ingestion-worker regained access after emergency grant. will update our integration tests to assert missing_permission error shape.

devex: will add SDK changelog entry + example error handling. Also adding a short troubleshooting FAQ to docs: how to interpret 403s -> check audit logs -> check role-mapper dry-run.

sam: thanks all. followups: docs PR 462, infra PR 781 (role-mapper fix), sdk PR 129 (wrap 403). Closing this thread once postmortem link is posted.
